paragraph: A neighbor went upstairs to check on Carole, an 87-year-old woman living alone with Parkinson’s Disease. Carole had no family nearby and had lived by herself for many years. After the check-in, neighbors and strangers began a fundraiser for her. They raised more than $109,000 to help her. Carole found out she was not as alone as she thought. She can rest now.

seed.summary: Neighbors and total strangers rallied around an 87-year-old woman with Parkinson’s Disease named Carole, raising more than $109,000 and proving she was much less alone than she thought. All it took was one person to take the time to check on the person who lived upstairs. Carole had lived alone for years, with no family
seed.sourceTitle: She Checked on Her ‘Loud’ Upstairs Neighbor, Inspiring Strangers to Raise More Than $100,000
